> **Zero Fake Live Claims Policy (PRD Section 1 & FR-043):**  
> This report states the exact, unvarnished truth regarding external TikTok platform permissions as of **27 October 2026**:

## 3. Sandbox Contract Verification Results (`tests/tiktok/test_tiktok_adapter.py`)

All safety, security, and resiliency invariants were verified using Python's standard-library `unittest` runner (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/tiktok -v`):

1. **Webhook Signature & Replay Verification (`test_webhook_signature_and_replay_defense`):**
   - Verifies valid `TikTok-Signature: t=<timestamp>,s=<hmac_sha256>` passes constant-time `hmac.compare_digest`.
   - Verifies tampered payloads, wrong secrets, and expired timestamps (`> 300s` skew) raise `SecurityConfigurationError`.
   - Verifies duplicate event replay is rejected (`ERR_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_DETECTED`).
   - Verifies self-authored comments by `@annreveals` set `should_ignore_self_comment=True` (`FR-003`).
2. **Outbound Host Allowlist & Scope Enforcement (`test_outbound_url_allowlist_and_scope_enforcement`):**
   - Verifies only `https://business-api.tiktok.com` and `https://open.tiktokapis.com` are permitted; any non-HTTPS or third-party host raises `SecurityConfigurationError`.
   - Verifies unapproved live calls truthfully report `AWAITING_APPROVAL` and raise `ScopeNotApprovedError` when strict check is requested.
3. **`TIKTOK_WRITE_ENABLED=false` Default Guard (`test_write_disabled_default_guard`):**
   - Verifies `TikTokAdapter` defaults to `write_enabled=False` and `OperationalMode.DRAFT`.
   - Verifies calling `reply_to_owned_comment` with `write_enabled=False` never dispatches a live write and saves the reply as `DispatchState.DRAFT_ONLY`.
4. **Permanent Prohibition on Third-Party Commenting & Scraping (`test_forbidden_third_party_commenting_and_following_scrape`):**
   - Verifies `comment_on_nonowned_post` and `get_following_posts` unconditionally raise `PermissionPolicyError("ERR_THIRD_PARTY_INTERACTION_PROHIBITED")` in both live and sandbox modes.
5. **Rate-Limit 429 Backoff & 5xx Circuit Breaker (`test_rate_limit_backoff_and_5xx_circuit_breaker`):**
   - Verifies HTTP `429` honors `Retry-After` and `30s/60s/120s` jittered backoff schedule (`NFR-02`).
   - Verifies 3 consecutive HTTP `503` responses trip the circuit breaker (`CircuitBreakerOpenError`).
6. **HTTP 401/403 Fail-Closed Auto-Downgrade to `DRAFT` (`test_401_403_fail_closed_auto_downgrade_to_draft`):**
   - Verifies that an upstream `401` or `403` during `reply_to_owned_comment` immediately downgrades `write_enabled=False`, sets `operational_mode=OperationalMode.DRAFT`, transitions the badge to `Needs reconnect`, and preserves the reply as `DRAFT_ONLY` (`NFR-10`).
7. **Sandbox Owned-Video Comment Read, Idempotent Reply & Provenance/Disclosure Checks (`test_sandbox_comment_read_reply_and_provenance_guards`):**
   - Verifies end-to-end sandbox comment listing, idempotent reply dispatch, timeout `RECONCILE_PENDING` state (`NFR-03`), anti-spam ownership comment deduplication (`FR-055`), and commercial disclosure validation (`FR-022`, `FR-026`).
